verdict.rationale: Smithery proxied tool calls through its Connect/Toolbox services, so an audit log of tool calls is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents call logging, audit trails, or replay. The shutdown notice also says Smithery is now a non-proxied registry, so no tool calls pass through it at all.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
